name: Blend Mode Pro
description: Blends the layer with everything below it, as an effect. Alternative to the built-in Blending Mode with every Darken, Lighten and Contrast mode plus Difference, Exclusion, Subtract, Divide, Hue, Saturation, Color, Luminosity and Dissolve, with Strength, Swap, Invert, Luma / Color only, Saturation, Linear Blend, Channels and Blend If. Keep the layer blending on Normal.
